Slide titled 'LUCI: PMMA'. O2 falls during the burn; not a constant. Next bullet: 'O2% rises back to 15.8% likely due to the decrease in gravity (and thus buoyant flow) which occurred at 125s.' (see not_found outcome:o2_mole_fraction_after_test). | Chamber O2 measured during the burn (an outcome of the closed chamber), NOT an ambient test condition; recorded as outcome only, never as o2_mole_fraction (independent audit, 2026-11-14).
